label: Goblin War Crown first encounter

purpose.value: In the middle of the Lantern Feast, the elected festival marshal steps through the fireworks to meet the armed stranger and issue the law's fair warning; the hero hears every word and misreads a festival guard as a war camp. The guardian attempts communication first; the hero misreads it as a villain's taunt.

emotionalProgression.note: The guardian announces itself and its duty plainly, framed by fireworks and the Lantern Feast.
The warning was honest and complete; being ignored reads as insult.

notes: The scene MUST establish the guardian announcing itself and warning honestly — the law of fair warning means its attack paths will be shown, not hidden. The mercy exit (withdraw) is offered and never taken. Flavor: fireworks and the Lantern Feast. The player's view may hint the guardian's true role; the hero must not perceive it. REQUIRED LINE SENTIMENT: "Stranger, lower your weapon. You have entered during the Lantern Feast." The scene happens DURING the festival — lanterns, fireworks, children watching from the palisade.
